purpose.summary: Interactive menu-driven maintenance program for a Voucher file, supporting Add, Change, Inquire, and Delete operations. It also reads a Vendor file for validation and a Control file to auto-generate sequential voucher numbers. Fields such as PAID-AMOUNT, PAID-DATE, and CHECK-NO are display-only and not modifiable.

notable_features: INSPECT CONVERTING for case-folding (lower to upper)
Auto-increment voucher number via a Control file
Conditional display of paid vs. unpaid voucher fields
Multiple COPY directives for file-control, FD, and working-storage sections
Date entry/validation via a shared GET-A-DATE routine (WSDATE01.CBL copybook)
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3 usage
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (589 total lines); the display routines for VOUCHER-DATE onward and file I/O paragraphs are cut off but the overall structure is clear. The COPY filenames and naming conventions (SLVND02, SLVOUCH, FDVND04, WSCASE01, WSDATE01) are consistent with the textbook series by Stern/Stern or a similar PC-COBOL curriculum package. The program uses a terminal-scroll approach (SCROLL-LINE 25 TIMES for clear-screen) typical of non-CICS batch-interactive programs.
